Bluegrass Mushroom Trip
My boyfriend and I heard about this sweet bluegrass camping festival about two hours away and decided it would be a great idea to go. Us and his friend drove to the festival about an hour after it had started, and half way through the car ride I pulled out my baggy of mushrooms and split it between his friend and I.
Only 20 minutes later they started to kick in, and I knew what to expect next because I had done them a couple times before. The clouds were unreal. They took over the sky and I swore the same bird kept flying around our car. We pull up to the camp grounds and a man with a sweet tie die shirt took my money (which I dont remember) and slapped a wristband on me (also dont remember) all I could say was 'nice shirt man.' We drive around till we find a spot and set up camp, and by now I am tripping so hard. We camp by a willow tree by a pristine pond.
I had never seen anything so beautiful. My boyfriend helped me onto this hammock underneath the willow and when I looked up the sky was moving and the tree was breathing. We start to walk towards the stage and I hear laughter everywhere. Objects of all sorts were swaying colors were unbelievable and I was speaking total nonsense. While watching the bands people had glowsticks which were insanely cool but my stomach was killing me. This was probably the worst I had ever felt on mushrooms.
This was probably the worst I had ever felt on mushrooms.
Eating small amounts of food, and drinking water was a short term cure.
By 1:30 a.m. My trip was a little less intense, and I knew I had to catch some sleep. Walking back to our tent I was excited because sleeping on mushrooms is just as interesting as being awake. I closed my eyes and saw the most incredible patterns. Colored flowers, pathways and people were unreal in the best way. Upon awakening, I was confused and looking at myself in the bathroom mirror I knew I became a different person the night before. I didnt mind it at all though.
